title: Reorder List
oneLinerQuestion: Reorder a linked list to interleave nodes from the start and the end.
explanation: 1. Find middle node using fast/slow pointers. 2. Reverse second half of linked list in-place. 3. Merge first half and reversed second half alternately.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION reorderList(head):
    slow = head, fast = head.next
    WHILE fast AND fast.next DO slow = slow.next; fast = fast.next.next
    second = slow.next; slow.next = NULL; prev = NULL
    WHILE second DO temp = second.next; second.next = prev; prev = second; second = temp
    first = head; second = prev
    WHILE second DO
        t1 = first.next, t2 = second.next
        first.next = second; second.next = t1
        first = t1; second = t2
    END WHILE
END FUNCTION

second = slow.next; slow.next = NULL; prev = NULL
WHILE second DO temp = second.next; second.next = prev; prev = second; second = temp

steps.narration: Line 2: Initialize slow = head (1), fast = head.next (2). Phase 1: Find middle node.
Line 3: Advance slow by 1 (to node 2) and fast by 2 (to node 4).
Line 3: Advance slow by 1 (to node 3). fast reached end boundary. Middle node located at 3.
Line 4: Split list at slow. Set second = slow.next (4), then disconnect slow.next = NULL.
Line 5: Phase 2: Reverse second half. Point node 4 backward: 4 -> NULL, prev = 4, second = 5.
Line 5: Reverse node 5: 5 -> 4. Reversed second half complete: [5 -> 4].
Line 6: Phase 3: Prepare interleave. Set first = head (1), second = prev (5).
Lines 8-9: Link first (1) -> second (5). Advance first to t1 (2).
Lines 8-9: Link second (5) -> next first node (2). Partial chain: 1 -> 5 -> 2.
Lines 8-9: Link node 2 -> node 4, then link node 4 -> remaining node 3.
Line 12: second pointer reached NULL. Reorder completed in-place: 1 -> 5 -> 2 -> 4 -> 3.
